description: Postiv helps you find strong content examples, turn your ideas and workspace knowledge into drafts, create images, carousels and infographics, and schedule LinkedIn posts. Manage connected personal profiles, teammates and company pages from one workspace. Review performance to find what works and repurpose successful posts. Read and reply to LinkedIn comments, manage approvals, and use saved writing styles and content plans. Publishing and engagement require a connected LinkedIn profile; drafts and workspace research can be used before connecting one.

defaultPrompt: Find my best-performing posts and suggest three fresh angles based on what worked.
Find my competitors best post and how we can make something similar but better
Show me this week’s content plan in Postiv and help me draft an unfinished item.
